themes_detail.label: Cannabis Retailer Complaints Surge
themes_detail.summary: Cannabis retailer complaints spiked to 4 THIS WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks—a 540% surge—suggesting either new unlicensed operators or enforcement crackdowns in Bay Ridge/Dyker Heights.
evidence: 4 cannabis retailer complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly baseline (540% spike, z-score: 3.94)
Spike is most recent signal in dataset—emerged within last 7 days
Suggests either rapid proliferation of unlicensed operators or community enforcement response
reporting_angles: Are unlicensed cannabis retailers opening in Bay Ridge? Map recent complaints and identify storefronts.
Interview SLA and NYPD about enforcement activity in the district this week—what triggered the spike?

themes_detail.label: Encampment Crisis Accelerating
themes_detail.summary: Encampment complaints jumped to 20 last week vs. 2.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks—a 742% spike—indicating a rapid homeless encampment expansion in the district, aligned with repeated CB budget requests for homeless services.
evidence: 20 encampment complaints last week vs. 2.4 weekly average (742% spike, z-score: 6.34, high severity)
Community Board has filed repeated budget requests for 'services for the homeless' year over year—signals chronic unmet need
Also corresponds with spike in 'standing water' complaints (4 last week vs 0.2 avg, 1500%), which may indicate unsanitary encampment conditions
reporting_angles: Locate the encampments by mapping 311 complaint geo-data. Are they concentrated on specific blocks or parks?
Interview residents and business owners near complaint hotspots about safety and sanitation concerns.
Contact DHS about why encampments are expanding in Bay Ridge and what resources exist.

themes_detail.label: Outdoor Dining & Vendor Crackdown
themes_detail.summary: Outdoor dining complaints surged to 5 last week (1233% spike) and vendor enforcement to 7 last week (700% spike), alongside mobile food vendor complaints (1500% spike to 4 last week), suggesting either aggressive new street vending or community backlash against outdoor dining structures.
evidence: Outdoor dining: 5 complaints last week vs. 0.4 weekly average (1233% spike, z-score: 6.65)
Vendor enforcement: 7 complaints last week vs. 0.9 weekly average (700% spike, z-score: 7.85)
Mobile food vendor: 4 complaints last week vs. 0.2 weekly average (1500% spike, z-score: 8.66)
All three metrics spiked simultaneously last week, suggesting coordinated street commerce expansion or community enforcement push
reporting_angles: Have new outdoor dining sheds appeared on Bay Ridge Avenue or nearby commercial corridors? Document locations and resident complaints.
Interview SLA and DOH about permitted vs. unpermitted food vendors operating in the district.
Are residents complaining about specific vendors or structural issues (blocked pedestrian access, noise, sanitation)?

themes_detail.label: Air Quality & Environmental Concerns
themes_detail.summary: Air quality complaints jumped to 8 last week vs. 1.4 weekly average—a 482% spike—potentially tied to construction activity, street vending operations, or emissions issues emerging in Bay Ridge.
evidence: Air quality complaints: 8 last week vs. 1.4 weekly average (482% spike, z-score: 5.03, high severity)
Coincides with surge in street vendor complaints, suggesting potential emissions or dust from food carts or construction
444 DOB permits filed in last 90 days (383 alterations, 23 new buildings, 7 demolitions) may be driving air quality degradation
reporting_angles: Map air quality complaints and cross-reference with active DOB construction sites. Are they correlated?
Contact DEP about ambient air monitoring data for Bay Ridge; has air quality deteriorated measurably?
Interview residents near complaint hotspots about perceived sources (traffic, construction, food vendors, other).

themes_detail.label: Food Establishment Violations Spike
themes_detail.summary: Food establishment complaints increased to 8 last week vs. 3.2 weekly average—a 146% spike—potentially signaling new restaurant openings, unsanitary conditions, or enforcement activity in the district.
evidence: Food establishment complaints: 8 last week vs. 3.2 weekly average (146% spike, z-score: 4.91, high severity)
Correlates with outdoor dining and mobile vendor spikes, suggesting broader food commerce expansion last week
Community Board budget requests include repeated calls for 'substance misuse de-stigmatization programs,' which may indicate food/beverage establishments serving alcohol or operating informally
reporting_angles: Identify which food establishments generated the spike in complaints via 311 data. Are they new or previously cited?
Contact DOH about inspection results for Bay Ridge restaurants last week.
What are residents complaining about—sanitation, noise, parking, or hours of operation?
